stats.Effect: The Storm Dragon Lindvior's underling. During the war against the gods, it fought together with the other dragons against the gods. After receiving a grave injury, it went deep into the woods and fell asleep. It recently awakened after feeling the power of Shilen flowing out from the Tower of Insolence. It is a bit smaller than a regular Drake, but because of its swift movements, it is sometimes mistaken for the Wind Dragon itself.
